# GitHub Topics

To add topics to your repository for better discoverability:

1. Go to https://github.com/psylsph/pi-desktop
2. Click the gear icon ⚙️ (top right) or go to Settings
3. Scroll down to "Topics" section
4. Add these topics (one per line, max 5):
   - desktop-app
   - electron
   - coding-agent
   - developer-tools
   - typescript

These topics help your repo appear in relevant searches and recommendations.
